title: Showcase Skin Pack Expansion — Zombie Garden, Cozy Cabin, Non-Euclidean & Amphibious
objective: Materialize four owner-requested post-UISR showcase Skin Packs through the shared Skin Pack runtime and evidence path: a zombies + exotic flowers skin, a cozy-play cozy cabin skin, a non-Euclidean skin whose visible UI framing/geometry itself expresses impossible-space identity, and a frogs/amphibious skin; preserve shared application semantics, accessibility, recoverability and presentation-only authority.

included: register and materialize four new Skin Pack identities through the shared runtime: zombie-garden, cozy-cabin, non-euclidean, and amphibious-frogs
define distinctive token/material/frame/ornament/typography/effect presentation contracts for each pack without forking gameplay/application semantics

make the non-Euclidean pack visibly non-Euclidean through deterministic presentational panel/frame geometry, impossible-angle offsets, nonparallel framing, nested perspective cues and bounded spatial dissonance while preserving logical DOM order, focus order, hit targets and readable content
add the four packs to gallery/assignment/persistence/full-capability packaging surfaces
add deterministic accessibility/reduced-motion/reduced-transparency/reduced-distraction behavior and non-color semantic preservation
produce focused tests proving registry resolution, presentation identity, non-Euclidean geometry contract, forbidden-authority boundaries, package manifests and full-capability inclusion
run exact-head validation and serialize application publication through the OPS3 FIFO publication queue
excluded: gameplay, rules, permissions, hidden-information, validation, provenance, AI or navigation authority changes
semantic reordering or DOM/task-topology mutation in the non-Euclidean skin
randomized control movement, inaccessible distortion, pointer-only interaction, reduced legibility or deceptive hitbox geometry
new skin identities beyond the four owner-requested showcase packs
scope.completion_gate: UISR-11 completes only when all four packs are selectable through the shared runtime, package/full-capability surfaces include them, the non-Euclidean pack demonstrates deterministic presentational geometry without changing interaction semantics, focused tests pass, required exact-head validation passes, publication is durably verified, and the UISR lane is atomically reconciled.

selection_boundaries: This is a newly governed post-terminal UISR expansion selected directly by the owner; it does not reopen or invalidate UISR-10.
The non-Euclidean skin may alter presentation geometry only; DOM/task topology, focus order, hit targets, semantics and authority remain application-owned.
All four packs remain declarative/non-executable Skin Packs and use shared runtime behavior.
Same-repository publication is serialized through the OPS3 FIFO queue.
next_action: Create the UISR-11 application branch from the governed app base, add a causal focused RED test for the four absent packs and non-Euclidean geometry contract, then implement to GREEN and continue through proof/publication/closeout.
